The shape with three sides is a triangle.

Based on the symptoms described, Mark is likely suffering from gallstones (cholelithiasis) or possibly cholecystitis. The severe abdominal pain worsening after high-fat meals is a classic sign of biliary colic, as fat stimulates the release of cholecystokinin, causing the gallbladder to contract against a blocked duct. The lighter-colored stool (acholic stool) and unusual itching (pruritus) suggest obstructive jaundice, indicating that a stone may be blocking the common bile duct, preventing bile from reaching the intestines and causing bilirubin to build up in the blood.
